rule: R2-DEC-031: frozen before any M10-B measurement; every measured row PARITY or IMPROVED in all eight dimensions, or wholly EXCLUDED with an intentional difference
runtime_identity: CPython 3.13 executing the exact pinned function sources from donor_functions.json in-process against the same metadata and asset fixtures as the M10 packaging check and export

dimension_criteria.functionality: M10 detects or produces every condition/output the donor does on the same fixture
dimension_criteria.correctness: M10 outcome matches the fixture ground truth; IMPROVED where the donor is wrong or silently drops a defect
dimension_criteria.determinism: two M10 runs give equal digests (IMPROVED when the donor output carries a wall-clock timestamp or is not byte-stable); PARITY for pure rules with equal outputs
dimension_criteria.failure_safety: on defect fixtures M10 never yields a passing/exported outcome where the donor passes, writes partial output or crashes untyped (IMPROVED); PARITY where both refuse
dimension_criteria.data_integrity: M10 binds content digests of every asset and of the metadata (IMPROVED over path-only donors); PARITY for pure text rules
dimension_criteria.observability: M10 returns typed rule/finding codes and receipts (IMPROVED over free-text issues/error strings); PARITY when both are typed
dimension_criteria.performance: PARITY iff M10 median wall time <= donor median + 1500 ms on the fixture; never IMPROVED
dimension_criteria.resources: IMPROVED iff M10 runs under declared byte/runtime ceilings (export in the confined unit); PARITY for pure in-process rules

rows.intentional_difference: M10-B variants are metadata/thumbnail alternatives chosen by the showrunner; media variants are separate approved masters governed by M8/M10-A, not packaging alternatives
M10 exports structured chapters (start_ms, title) in metadata.json; pasteable description.txt/tags.txt/chapters.txt text is a platform publisher presentation concern outside export-only M10-B
M10 places captions per locale under captions/<locale>.<ext> from captions-<locale> roles, so multi-locale captions never collide
